invariants: permutations come only from the preregistered allowed sequence set
washout rows never re-enter the primary statistic
the test statistic is frozen before outcomes are inspected
a sharp-null randomization p-value is not mislabeled as a general average-effect confidence interval
carryover and periodicity diagnostics have independent downgrade authority
serial dependence is handled at period or randomization level, never by treating orders as iid

implemented_scope.assignment_model: uniform over explicitly registered allowed sequences
implemented_scope.enumeration: exact only; sampled Monte Carlo p-values fail closed
implemented_scope.confidence_interval: unsupported; randomization p-value cannot be relabeled as a general average-effect interval
implemented_scope.diagnostics: periodicity, lag and carryover terms are surfaced but require independent sensitivity analysis
